notes: E. coli C ATCC 8739 derivatives in AM1 mineral salts with 5% glucose + 5% xylose, pH-controlled fermenter. Precursor strain PS is taken as the reference the evolved (AE) and reverse-engineered (REV) strains are compared against; the precursor's own engineering is not described. REV genotype class left out (mutations not described). Oxygen not stated.
